Both confirmed — that locks in the saving flow nicely. On your two remaining points:

- **Real icon and preview image** — that's the visual-polish item I've already noted; I'll bring it back once the functional flows are settled.
- **Correcting details after a bookmark is saved** — good, that's a distinct capability (editing an existing bookmark, not just at save time). I'll make that one of the next flows we walk through.

Before we move on, a quick **summary check on the saving flow** so I know it's solid:

1. You paste a link and its title & description are fetched automatically, shown in editable fields you can correct.
2. If the lookup fails, you get a calm notice and can still save, typing your own title.
3. If you save with no title, the link itself becomes the title.
4. You can attach your own tags and a context note, then save, and the bookmark appears in your list.

**Does all of that match your intent?** Once you confirm, I'll set up the next screen where we look at your saved bookmarks — including correcting a saved one, and the "to read / done / archived" distinction you described.
